name: report
description: Report a member to the moderators of this server.
modalReasonPlaceholder: Tell the moderators what happened. Only they will see your report.
notConfigured: Reports are not set up in this server. An administrator can set the reports channel with `/settings server`.
targetWolf: You cannot report me. If something I did is wrong, tell the moderators of this server.
targetWebhook: This message was not written by a member, so there is nobody to report.
cooldown: You sent a report less than {{seconds, number}} seconds ago, please wait before you send another one.
duplicate: This message was already reported, the moderators will look at it.
expired: This report took too long to write, please start it again.
failed: I could not deliver your report. Please tell a moderator of this server directly.
success: Thank you, your report was sent to the moderators. Only they can see it.
actionDone: Done, it is case #{{case, number}}. The report is closed.
actionFailed: Something went wrong and the action was not taken. The report is still open.
deleteDone: The reported message was deleted. The report is still open, in case its author needs an action.
deleteFailed: I could not delete the reported message, I may be missing the permission to manage messages in its channel.
